description: TPG collisions with third parties is a dataset listed in Tpg open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Tpg. This dataset provides a list of accidents involving TPG vehicles, other types of vehicles, and pedestrians. It includes a synthetic severity index that integrates human, operational, material, and media factors to offer an overall assessment of the severity of each accident. Coverage: Geneva (tpg network). The portal files it under Sécurity. Its keywords are Sécurité. The portal shows 10,379 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-05-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-tpg-ch-portal.
